name: split-flap-board
title: Split Flap Board
description: An airport-style flap display where each cell flips through cards top-over-bottom to reach its target; half-flap seams, staggered columns and the characteristic clack pacing are all CSS-only per cell.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Value Sweep: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
